name: seal_manifest
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import os,json,hashlib,subprocess,sys,datetime
L='/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/new-twenty-2026-10-31/regular-palm-locating-primary-qualification-claude-r1'
EXCL={'MANIFEST.json':'the manifest itself, which cannot contain its own hash','seal_manifest.receipt.json':'runner receipt of this sealing run, written after the child exits','seal_manifest.output.txt':'runner output of this sealing run, written after the child exits'}
rows=[]
for r,d,f in os.walk(L):
    d.sort()
    for x in sorted(f):
        p=os.path.join(r,x); rel=os.path.relpath(p,L)
        if rel in EXCL: continue
        assert not os.path.islink(p),rel
        b=open(p,'rb').read(); rows.append({'path':rel,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
fa=json.load(open(L+'/frozen-after.json')); assert fa['mismatches']==[] and fa['count']==22
m={'kind':'exhaustive own-lane byte manifest for MathDB 344875 independent qualification','utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'file_count':len(rows),'terminal_self_exclusions':EXCL,'frozen_after':{'count':fa['count'],'mismatches':fa['mismatches']},'credit':0,'files':rows}
s=json.dumps(m,indent=1)+'\n'
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',L+'/write_lane.py','MANIFEST.json'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True)
assert z.returncode==0,z.stderr
back=open(L+'/MANIFEST.json','rb').read(); assert back==s.encode()
print('files',len(rows),'manifest_sha256',hashlib.sha256(back).hexdigest())
names=[x['path'] for x in rows]
print('have',[n for n in ['REVIEW.md','PROOF.md','source-map.json','review.json','frozen-before.json','frozen-after.json','guard-ledger.jsonl','search-charges.jsonl','searches/search-1-full-response.txt','searches/search-2-full-response.txt'] if n in names])
print('receipts',sum(n.endswith('.receipt.json') for n in names))
